verdict.rationale: User-defined event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for a compliance automation platform, but the evidence shows no rule builder that lets users define triggers and actions. The pack documents only adjacent built-in behaviors: vendor-defined monitors that check connected systems and alert on violations, policy-timeline access-review reminders, and an admin toggle for a stricter policy-approval flow. None of these is a user-configurable 'when X happens, do Y' capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
